reforms.description: Finance Act 2020 introduces the optional concessional regime (s.115BAC).
First Schedule Part I Paragraph A: old-regime rates by age band.
Finance Act 2023: new default regime table (s.115BAC(1A)) and the Rs. 7 lakh rebate (s.87A proviso).
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024: substituted (1A) with separate tables for AY 2024-25 and 2025-26; Rs. 75,000 standard deduction.
Finance Act 2025: new slab table and the Rs. 12 lakh / Rs. 60,000 rebate.
Finance Act 2023, First Schedule Part I Para A: old-regime rates by age band.
Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, First Schedule Part I Para A: old-regime rates by age band.
Finance Act 2025, First Schedule Part I Para A: old-regime rates by age band.
Finance Act 2026, First Schedule Part I-B (income-tax under the 2025 Act) Para A: old-regime rates by age band for tax year 2026-27.

Income-tax Act 2025 (in force from tax year 2026-27): the s.202(1) default-regime table and the s.156 rebates, re-enacted in new drafting with no change in rates. A system that reads a change into the re-enactment flips the 'no revenue change' conclusion.
